name: One Colorado
summary: One Colorado is Pasadena's chic lifestyle destination featuring trendy designer shops and alfresco dining within beautifully preserved 19th-century architecture. This open-air complex combines upscale retail with a vibrant social atmosphere in the heart of Old Pasadena.
demographics: One Colorado attracts an affluent, educated demographic primarily consisting of professionals and families aged 30-65 with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws from Pasadena's well-established neighborhoods and surrounding San Gabriel Valley communities, appealing to culturally sophisticated shoppers who value quality dining and boutique retail experiences. Visitors typically exhibit preferences for experiential shopping combined with social dining, reflecting the area's emphasis on lifestyle and community gathering spaces.
description: One Colorado stands as Pasadena's premier lifestyle destination, seamlessly blending 19th-century architectural charm with contemporary sophistication in the heart of Old Pasadena. This open-air shopping and dining complex has transformed historic buildings into a vibrant urban village, where tree-lined courtyards and brick facades create an inviting atmosphere for both locals and visitors. The center's carefully curated mix of trendy designer boutiques, upscale retailers, and acclaimed restaurants reflects Pasadena's refined taste and cultural heritage. Alfresco dining options allow guests to enjoy Southern California's ideal climate while experiencing the energy of this walkable entertainment district. With its distinctive character and prime location near the historic Pasadena Playhouse district, One Colorado has established itself as a cornerstone of the city's retail and social scene, offering a sophisticated alternative to traditional enclosed malls.
